name: Anidol Colors
source:
Aim for the top of Sirius!

Equipped with animalistic traits, animal idols (otherwise known as anidols) are what boys dream of becoming. In hopes of realising that dream, they attend Sirius Academy, an institution renown for training future anidols. You have been chosen as a Cure Manager for a select few of those boys.

Your daily life with the up-and-coming idol unit, 7Colors, begins here...

[Translated from [url=https://dream.voltage.co.jp/anidol/]official website[/url]]
translation:
瞄准天狼星的顶端！

具有动物特征的动物偶像（也称为anidols）是男孩们梦想成为的人。为了实现这个梦想，他们进入了天狼星学院，这是一家以培养未来的阿尼多而闻名的机构。你被选为其中几个男孩的治愈经理。

你与新晋偶像组合7Colors的日常生活就从这里开始……

【翻译自[url=https://dream.voltage.co.jp/anidol/]官网[/url]】
